paper_title: Continual Dialogue State Tracking via Reason-of-Select Distillation
caption: : Avg. JGA score at each turn

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average JGA (Joint Goal Accuracy) score across different turn IDs, comparing two models: LLaMA-7B and T5-small. The horizontal axis represents the Turn ID, labeled from 0 to 26 at regular intervals, while the vertical axis indicates the Avg. JGA Score, with a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 1 in increments of 0.1. The chart features two sets of grouped bars for each Turn ID, where each group contains one orange bar for LLaMA-7B and one yellow bar for T5-small. The orange bars generally achieve higher scores than the yellow bars, with values starting near 0.9 at Turn ID 0 for LLaMA-7B, decreasing down to around 0.45 at Turn ID 26 with a bit of fluctuation in between. The yellow bars begin slightly below 0.9 at Turn ID 0 and decline to approximately 0.35 by Turn ID 26, with the lowest bar at Turn ID 24. The bar chart is sorted by Turn ID sequentially from left to right, without any additional visual emphasis or annotations on specific bars. A legend is placed at the top right of the plot.
